insights.claim: Joint D3_GATHER_MASK x D4_COLD_MASK full-space SA landed 1120->1111 cycles (PSPACE=1) / 1180 (PSPACE=0): tail-packing win on the load engine with synergy masks d3={0,1,2,3,4,34,35,44,45,50,54} d4={7,12,16,22,24,33,37}. The best mask has highest load (1083.5, near un-masked 1087.5).

Load floor (~1083.5) still >> alu sub-floor (1036.7). Best mask at 1111 has the highest load; pushing load down independently hurts realized cycles. Sub-1111 needs a load-floor mover that ALSO improves tail scheduling — not a pure load-cut axis.
insights.actionable_hint: Target the load floor (~1083.5, 47 cycles above alu sub-floor) with an axis that cuts load AND improves scheduler tail simultaneously. Candidate axes: D4_SCRATCH recycler rollup (VLIW-25/VLIW-26) or D4_FREE engine-split (VLIW-20). Pure load-cut axes (VLIW-16 d4-mux, VLIW-23 mem-bake) are NO-GO per established killtests.

insights.claim: Hard dual PSPACE gate: PSPACE=1 < best (now 1111), PSPACE=0 <= 1187 (now 1180). rot-27 oracle is a strict upper bound on full-32 realized, usable as cheap search signal. Do not modify tests/.
